import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 装备分类处理器
 * 路由:
 *   /储物袋 装备 - 显示装备类型按钮（动态）
 *   /储物袋 装备 武器 - 显示武器列表
 *   /储物袋 装备 武器 2 - 显示武器第2页
 *
 * 注意：装备仍使用 userEquipments 表，暂未迁移到 userItems
 */

import { DEFAULT_PAGE, EMPTY_STRING, ZERO_VALUE as EMPTY_TOTAL, FIRST_ARG_INDEX, MIN_PAGE, SECOND_ARG_INDEX } from '@src/constants';
import App from '@src/response-apps/storage/newBag/equipments/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { addOptions, createQuoteMarkdown, FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, logger, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';
import { renderSubTabs } from '../tabs';
import { equipmentItemActions, equipmentPageActions } from '../capabilities';

/**
 * 解析命令参数
 */
const parseCommand = (msg: string): { equipmentType: string | null; page: number } => {
  // 移除命令前缀和"装备"
  const args = msg.replace(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?(我的)?(储物袋|背包)\s+装备\s*/, EMPTY_STRING).trim();

  if (!args) {
    return { equipmentType: null, page: DEFAULT_PAGE };
  }

  const parts = args.split(/\s+/);
  let equipmentType: string | null = null;
  let page = DEFAULT_PAGE;

  // 第一个参数可能是装备类型或页码
  if (parts[FIRST_ARG_INDEX]) {
    // 如果是数字，当作页码处理
    if (!isNaN(Number(parts[FIRST_ARG_INDEX]))) {
      page = Math.max(MIN_PAGE, Number(parts[FIRST_ARG_INDEX]));
    } else {
      // 否则当作装备类型
      equipmentType = parts[FIRST_ARG_INDEX];
      // 第二个参数是页码
      if (parts[SECOND_ARG_INDEX] && !isNaN(Number(parts[SECOND_ARG_INDEX]))) {
        page = Math.max(MIN_PAGE, Number(parts[SECOND_ARG_INDEX]));
      }
    }
  }

  return { equipmentType, page };
};

const response = onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  try {
    const uid = e.uid as number;
    const { equipmentType, page } = parseCommand((e.MessageText || EMPTY_STRING).replace(/\s+操作(?=\s|$)/, ''));

    const result = await App({ bid, uid, equipmentType, page });

    if (result.code !== 'OK') {
      throw new Error('查询装备失败，请稍后重试');
    }

    const baseCommand = equipmentType ? `/储物袋 装备 ${equipmentType}` : '/储物袋 装备';

    if (/\s+操作(?:\s|$)/.test(e.MessageText ?? '')) {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown().addText('选择批量操作；分解前会展示本批收益并要求确认，每次最多300件。');

      void message.send(
        FormatGui({
          isPrivate,
          bid,
          title: '装备 · 批量处理',
          content: md,
          footer: [...equipmentPageActions(result.data.capabilities), { label: '返回装备', command: baseCommand }]
        })
      );

      return;
    }

    const { types, activeType, total, totalPages, items } = result.data;
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    // 二级子类 tabs（动态，内联 markdown）
    const subTabs = types.map(t => ({ label: `[${t}]`, command: `/储物袋 装备 ${t}` }));

    renderSubTabs(md, subTabs);

    if (!activeType) {
      md.addText('暂无装备类型');

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', header: [{ label: '返回', command: '/储物袋' }], content: md }));

      return;
    }

    // 如果总数为0，显示暂无物品
    if (total === EMPTY_TOTAL) {
      md.addText('该类型暂无装备');

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', header: [{ label: '返回', command: '/储物袋' }], content: md }));

      return;
    }

    // 格式化装备显示，添加快捷按钮和属性
    items.forEach(item => {
      const lines = [`【${item.id}】`, `「${item.displayName}」 ${item.displayGrade} · ${item.displayEquipmentType}`];

      for (let i = 0; i < item.attributeParts.length; i += 2) {
        const attrPair = item.attributeParts.slice(i, i + 2).join(' ｜ ');

        lines.push(attrPair);
      }
      md.addText(lines[0]);
      addOptions(md, equipmentItemActions(item));
      md.addText(lines[1]).addNewline();
      if (lines.length > 2) {
        md.addBlockquote(createQuoteMarkdown(lines.slice(2)));
      }
      md.addNewline();

      md.addNewline();
      md.addNewline();
    });

    // 操作按钮放入 bar

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '储物袋 · 装备',
        header: [{ label: '返回', command: '/储物袋' }],
        content: md,
        nav: {
          current: page,
          total: totalPages,
          command: `/储物袋 装备 ${activeType} {page}`
        },
        footer: [
          { label: '我的装备', command: '/我的装备' },
          { label: '批量处理', command: `${baseCommand} 操作` }
        ]
      })
    );
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('装备分类处理失败:', error);
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('查询装备失败，请稍后重试');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, header: [{ label: '返回', command: '/储物袋' }], content: md }));
  }
});

export default response;
